title: The sound of dynamical dark energy and modified gravity
efc_relevance: Joint constraint on dark-energy sound speed and (µ, Σ) using Planck PR4 + Pantheon+ + DESI DR2 + DES-Y3; the (µ, Σ) plane sampled here is exactly EFC's perturbation-sector signature (µ < 1, Σ > 1) and the paper reports a correlation between modified-gravity preference and dynamical-DE preference. Direct, simultaneous test of FA2 and EFC P3.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as joint (µ, Σ, c_s²) probe; cross-reference framework:fR-Starobinsky2007 (opposite µ-sign), framework:Horndeski-Deffayet2011 and arXiv:2503.14738; required head-to-head in WP3 Falsification Protocol — paper's (µ, Σ) posterior is the cleanest near-term discriminator for FA2.
